Välj ett koncernföretag där du får skapa: Choose a group company where you may create vouchers.
Choose what kind of intra-group item it is.
Det finns redan ett motsvarande utkast i: There is already a matching draft in :company for voucher :reference.
Ett motsvarande utkast kan bara göras fr: A matching draft can only be made from a posted voucher, by someone who may create vouchers.
Fakturan kunde inte levereras till konce: The invoice could not be delivered to the group company. Check with the recipient that the company accepts group invoices from you, or send the invoice another way.
:title är redan levererad till koncernfö: :title has already been delivered to the group company.
Kunden är inte markerad som koncernföret: The customer is not marked as a group company. Mark it under Bookkeeping → Group markings first.
Organisationsnumret på fakturan stämmer: The organisation number on the invoice does not match the customer's group marking.
Ett testföretag levererar inga fakturor: A test company does not deliver invoices to group companies.
Koncernkreditfaktura :number från :name: Group credit invoice :number from :name
Koncernfaktura :number från :name: Group invoice :number from :name
Bara företagets ägare eller administratö: Only the company's owner or administrator can change which group companies may deliver invoices here.
Skriv serie och nummer, till exempel A12: Enter the series and number, for example A12, in at most 40 characters.
Företaget tar nu emot koncernfakturor fr: The company now accepts group invoices from that group company.
Företaget tar inte längre emot koncernfa: The company no longer accepts group invoices from that group company.
:title är levererad till koncernföretage: :title has been delivered to the group company's inbox.
Ett motsvarande utkast är skapat i konce: A matching draft has been created in the group company. It is posted by whoever keeps the books there.
The counterpart's voucher has been saved.
Ett annat företag i samma koncern som oc: Another company in the same group that also uses NONOX can deliver its invoices straight to the company's inbox, but only the group companies listed here. The invoice arrives as an e-invoice and is handled like any supplier invoice.
Inga koncernföretag får leverera fakturo: No group company may deliver invoices here
Lägg till organisationsnumret för ett ko: Add the organisation number of a group company that may deliver its invoices to the company's inbox. The inbox must be on.
Fakturor från :number levereras inte län: Invoices from :number will no longer be delivered to the inbox. Invoices that have already arrived stay.
De här leverantörerna är markerade som k: These suppliers are marked as group companies.
Fakturor som företaget har levererat til: Invoices the company has delivered to another group company's inbox. You only see whether the invoice arrived, not how the recipient handles it.
Öppna en utfärdad faktura till en kund s: Open an issued invoice to a customer marked as a group company and choose Deliver to the group company.
Mellanhavanden utan faktura som bokförs: Intra-group items without an invoice that are booked in both companies, for example loans, interest and group contributions. Create a matching draft from a posted voucher.
Öppna en bokförd verifikation och välj S: Open a posted voucher and choose Create matching draft. You need to be allowed to create vouchers in both companies.
Fakturan ligger i koncernföretagets inko: The invoice is in the group company's inbox. That company's own users interpret, register and approve it as a supplier invoice. You do not see how it is handled.
Kunden är markerad som koncernföretaget: The customer is marked as the group company :number.
Fakturan levereras som e-faktura till ko: The invoice is delivered as an e-invoice to the group company's inbox in NONOX. A delivered invoice cannot be taken back; correct it with a credit invoice instead. The bookkeeping is not affected.
Fakturan går som e-faktura enligt Peppol: The invoice goes as a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 e-invoice with the PDF attached, straight to the company's inbox in NONOX. The recipient must have chosen to accept group invoices from you.
Ett mellanhavande inom koncernen utan fa: An intra-group item without an invoice, for example a loan, interest or a group contribution, is booked in both companies.
Serie och nummer hos motparten: Series and number at the counterpart
NONOX föreslår raderna med debet och kre: NONOX proposes the rows with debit and credit swapped and makes a draft in the group company. The draft is posted by whoever keeps the books there.
Kontona är föreslagna. Kontrollera att d: The accounts are proposals. Check that they exist in the counterpart's chart of accounts and, for example, change a receivable into a debt. The amounts are the voucher's and cannot be changed here.
Ett utkast skapas i koncernföretaget. De: A draft is created in the group company. It is not posted until someone there posts it.
Koncernfaktura levererad i NONOX av ett: Group invoice delivered in NONOX by another company in the group
Kontrollera kontot hos motparten: Check the account at the counterpart
En inläst faktura från ett annat program: An invoice imported from another program has no NONOX original and cannot be delivered to a group company.
Fakturor som levererades till ett annat: Invoices delivered to another group company's inbox in NONOX, as the e-invoice file (Peppol BIS Billing 3.0) that left the company (:count files).
